subject: Structured rebate proposal & fallback pricing for renewal
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire@novalogic.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@novalogic.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal options — rebate tied to usage uplift?

Hi Sofia,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're starting budgeting conversations for next year and want to lock in our Redwood renewal. Two quick asks from procurement:

- Can you share a banded rebate structure that scales with actual usage uplift (we think we'll grow ~30–60% next year)?
- If we co-term now to sync with our fiscal year (Jan 1), what pricing fallback applies if we materially exceed the forecast mid-contract?

Also attaching the PO formatting requirements so your billing team can confirm what we need to send.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Dunn
Head of Cloud Ops, Novalogic
Attachment: Novalogic_PO_Requirement.xlsx (excel)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire@novalogic.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal options — rebate tied to usage uplift?

Claire — thanks for the clear asks and the PO template. Looping in Marcus (commercial finance) and Neha (account lead) so we can align on terms and the fallback mechanism.

High-level proposal (two options):

1) Graduated rebate + co-term (recommended)
- Base: 12-month renewal starting 2026-01-01 co-term to your FY.
- Rebate bands (applied to overage unit price post-baseline): 0–25% uplift => 5% rebate; 25–50% => 10% rebate; 50%+ => 17.5% rebate.
- Baseline = 12-month trailing avg leading up to renewal.
- Payout: quarterly credit against invoice.

2) Fixed up-front discount + overage floor (simpler)
- One-time 8% discount on committed units if you sign to co-term now.
- If actual usage exceeds committed units by >40% in any month, overage billed at a pre-agreed incremental rate (we can cap at 1.6x list).

Fallback pricing mechanism (for both)
- If usage materially exceeds forecast for two consecutive quarters (>40% month-over-month on average), we convert to an interim uplift pricing for the remainder of the contract: either a blended uplift on unit price or a negotiated short-term top-up commitment to maintain discounted rates. Marcus — can you confirm acceptable uplift caps from finance?

Next steps: if either option looks reasonable, I can produce a clean term sheet and a version with the rebate formula exported as a spreadsheet so your FP&A can model it.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novalogic_Renewal_Termsheet_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Claire Dunn <claire@novalogic.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal options — rebate tied to usage uplift?

Sofia / Claire — quick finance view. We are comfortable with the graduated rebate structure if we add two guardrails:

1) A quarterly reconciliation window with a one-month notice to trigger rate conversion.
2) A maximum aggregate rebate cap of 20% of annual committed value (to protect against extreme viral spikes).

Operationally, the rebate will appear as a credit line on subsequent invoices; we can provide a monthly reconciliation export. For the uplift cap on interim pricing, 1.5x list is our upper bound before we require a short-term committed top-up.

Claire — if that aligns, Sofia and I can incorporate the guardrails into the term sheet and send for your legal/finance review.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@novalogic.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Dunn <claire@novalogic.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal options — rebate tied to usage uplift?

Thanks — all that looks workable. A couple of clarifications from procurement:

- Can you provide the rebate bands as a downloadable spreadsheet (so our FP&A can run sensitivity)?
- We need the fallback interim-pricing formula spelled out in the contract (not just an email), including the precise trigger and notification cadence.

Assuming those two items are included in the next draft, we can route to legal and get a PO out the week of Sep 22. Please also include your standard DocuSign link for the term sheet.

Tom Reyes
Sr. Procurement Manager, Novalogic
